notes.mock_mode: auto = use real Kronos if it loads, else fall back to clearly-labeled mock. true = force mock. false = require real model (raise if it cannot load).
notes.device: auto = detect cuda/mps/cpu. Override with 'cuda:0', 'mps', or 'cpu'.
notes.sample_count: Number of INDEPENDENT forecast paths collected to build the distribution. The adapter loops upstream predict(sample_count=1) because upstream predict averages samples internally.
notes.context_length: Number of trailing candles fed to the model. Must be <= max_context for the chosen variant.
